evidence: The MgO films obtained were analysed by time-of-flight elastic recoil detection analysis (TOF-ERDA), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), X-ray diffraction (XRD) and atomic force microscopy (AFM) to determine chemical composition, crystallinity and crystallite orientation as well as surface morphology. The depth proﬁling of MgO thin ﬁlms was carried out using time-of-ﬂight elastic recoil detection analysis (TOF-ERDA). XPS measurements were carried out at the HUT Center for Chemical Analysis. Surface morphologies of the ﬁlms were examined by a Nanoscope III atomic force microscope (Digital Instruments). Thicknesses were also determined by ﬁtting the optical spectra ... The crystallite orientation of thin ﬁlms was determined by recording the XRD diagrams ... Surface morphology of the deposited ﬁlms was analyzed by AFM. The surface composition of MgO ﬁlm deposited at 300 ‡C using optimised deposition parameters was also studied with XPS.
